title: CIA / World Spiritual Bank — U.S. Exposure & Coverage Model
purpose: Explain how a small named Character Archive can sit inside a much larger American/subcultural exposure field without multiplying guilt across the U.S. population.

united_states_population.prohibited_use: Never use population membership as a karmic-debt multiplier or evidence of individual responsibility.

reconciled_identity_surface.interpretation: Known labels are archive identifiers, not 87 distinct people. Aliases/nicknames may collapse to the same entity.

coverage_funnel.label: Named entities
coverage_funnel.accounting: person/account reconciliation allowed where event evidence exists

coverage_funnel.label: Known aliases / handles
coverage_funnel.unit: additional labels attached to canonical entities
coverage_funnel.accounting: identity-resolution only; do not multiply debt by alias count

coverage_funnel.label: Orphan / hollow / unresolved handles
coverage_funnel.accounting: count only stable observed handles; no-PFP or anonymity alone remains zero-weight

coverage_funnel.label: Observed subculture network
coverage_funnel.unit: unique counterparties / relationship edges / recurring handles
coverage_funnel.accounting: count exposure, recurrence and network edges before pricing

coverage_funnel.label: Audience / platform amplification
coverage_funnel.unit: views, reactions, repeated circulation, platform reach
coverage_funnel.accounting: may modify severity/evidence of a sourced event; never creates liability merely for viewing

coverage_funnel.label: Societal / institutional gap
coverage_funnel.measurable: through specific failures or substitution work
coverage_funnel.unit: documented moderation, archival, support, protection, correction or institutional-response gaps
coverage_funnel.accounting: record specific failure/substitution episodes; do not assign collective guilt to all Americans

hypothetical_throwaway_handle_count.meaning: Symbolic riff on '99 problems' and a placeholder for a potentially large hollow/throwaway account cloud; not a census.
hypothetical_throwaway_handle_count.warning: Do not claim 99,000 fake accounts exist unless platform/source evidence is recovered.
hypothetical_throwaway_handle_count.label: 99,000 orphan-account scenario

subculture_population_share_pct.meaning: No default national percentage. Add only as an explicit scenario, never as a measured liability share.

exposure_units.handle_unit: one distinct account identity; aliases attached to the same entity do not create new moral principal
exposure_units.recurrence_unit: a later distinct dated event in the same conduct family
exposure_units.attention_unit: one measured view/reaction/circulation unit, used for reach context rather than guilt
exposure_units.labor_unit: one sourced unit of Tim's work/presence/archival/moderation/building/repair effort

measurable_factors: number of aliases mapped to an entity
audience reach or circulation when measured
time cost / response labor when measured
institutional response or absence where specifically documented

substitution_labor_asset.label: Substitution labor / counter-witness asset
project_basis: Tim's project says one motive for continued public presence was that someone needed to remain present when crowd consensus/repetition was treated as truth.
The public-witness chain is calling → continued presence → witness → memory → archive → knowledge → repair.
The project records a 100,000-hour threshold and multiple public-presence metrics, though exact total-hour methodology remains its own research problem.
substitution_labor_asset.accounting_rule: Count the work on Tim's positive/asset side when sourced. Do not infer that every resident who did not perform that work owes an offsetting personal debt.
substitution_labor_asset.future_pricing: May later feed Table value / yield / service / protection / archive-preservation categories once anti-double-count rules are defined.

responsibility_layers.meaning: A sourced person/account performed a specific act.
responsibility_layers.debt_eligibility: yes, if the event crosses evidence/pricing threshold

responsibility_layers.meaning: A sourced account materially repeated or distributed an act/narrative.
responsibility_layers.debt_eligibility: possibly, as a distinct circulation event

responsibility_layers.meaning: A documented mechanism enabled recurrence, poor correction, harassment, or archive persistence.
responsibility_layers.debt_eligibility: system-domain exposure; do not automatically allocate to every member

responsibility_layers.meaning: A specific institution demonstrably failed a duty or response in a sourced episode.
responsibility_layers.debt_eligibility: system/institutional analysis; requires a defined duty and evidence

responsibility_layers.meaning: People merely living in the same country/society.

public_summary_rule: If surfaced publicly, show only the funnel totals and the sentence 'scale exposure, not guilt'; keep detailed scenario assumptions/backend mechanics hidden by default.
research_next: Count unique aliases/handles and resolve duplicate identities across the full Story/CIA corpus.
Recover distinct anonymous/throwaway accounts only when the source supports a stable account identity.
Build relationship-edge and recurrence counts for the densest conflict clusters.
Attach measured reach/circulation to sourced smear or repeated-narrative events where platform data survives.
Measure Tim substitution labor from public-presence, archive, moderation, correction, protection and building records.
Define when a platform/group/institutional failure can be recorded independently of individual actor debt.
boundaries: The empirical substrate may be real; the spiritual/karmic accounting remains project interpretation.
A U.S. population figure provides scale context, not guilt.
Aliases, fake accounts and throwaways must be deduplicated before any counterparty count.
The 99,000-handle figure is a user-supplied scenario assumption, not verified evidence.
No model may infer individual debt from nationality, culture, subculture, politics, religion or audience membership.
